title: Palletize in layers
summary: Load four boxes into a layer, square it, carry it with a clamp head and stack three layers on a pallet.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Build a layer by counting pairs of boxes, and square it before the clamp takes it.
Set each layer at its own height, one box height higher than the one below.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/LayerPalletizer.st, repeat three times: load two pairs of boxes (Emit1 and Emit2 together make a pair, EyeIn counts them), wait for LayerReady, square, retract, take the layer with the clamp, carry it to XMax, lower it by a height that depends on Layer, release and return.
stages.checkpoint: Layer counts the finished layers and chooses the lowering of each one; the same states run for every layer.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, follow the head: it starts at its lowest and rises first, the first layer goes down to YMin, and each later layer stops one box height higher than the previous one.
stages.checkpoint: The pusher is retracted before the head moves; the clamp opens only over the pallet; Green lights after the third layer.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter drives no output, so the head never rises and no box arrives; load, square, carry and set three layers of four boxes on the pallet and light Green at the end.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the layer-palletizer scenario; watch the 3D view while it runs.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named layer-palletizer and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the layer: four boxes in a block in the zone, carried together, and set on the pallet or on the layer below without falling.
stages.checkpoint: No box drops, and Amber is on from the start until the third layer is down.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: A single loop of states handles every layer because Layer changes the one thing that differs: the lowering. The scenario proves that the clamp placed items, that boxes rest on pallet 0, that no box was dropped and that Green is on at the end. The facts do not count three layers of four exactly, and the jog times are timed, not measured.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish physical gripper timing, axis speed, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Keep one counter for the pairs sent and one for the pairs seen at EyeIn, so the belt carries only two pairs; Layer says which layer is next and drives the lowering.

Lower the first layer to YMin; for the others use a timed jog from YMax chosen by Layer, found by trial in the trace (the second layer needs a longer jog than the third), so each layer stops one box height higher than the previous.

faultCases: The starter drives no output, so the head never rises and no box arrives; load, square, carry and set three layers of four boxes on the pallet and light Green at the end.
